stimulus: The city council decided to ban plastic bags because they harm marine life. However, the ban will also reduce jobs at plastic manufacturing plants.
questionText: Which of the following is an assumption upon which the argument depends?
optionA: The council values environmental protection more than job preservation
optionB: Plastic bags are the primary cause of marine pollution
optionC: The council has considered the economic impact of the ban
optionD: Marine life is more important than human employment
optionE: Reducing plastic bags will have minimal impact on the economy
explanation: The argument assumes that environmental protection outweighs job concerns. This is a necessary assumption because without it, the argument would fall apart. If the council didn't value environmental protection more, the decision wouldn't make sense.

stimulus: Studies show that people who exercise regularly have lower rates of heart disease. Therefore, exercise prevents heart disease.
questionText: Which of the following, if true, most strengthens the argument?
optionA: People who exercise also tend to eat healthier diets
optionB: Exercise increases heart rate and blood flow
optionC: Some people who exercise still develop heart disease
optionD: Heart disease is the leading cause of death
optionE: The correlation between exercise and lower heart disease rates is stronger than previously thought
explanation: This option strengthens the argument by suggesting the correlation is even stronger than stated, supporting the causal claim. Options A and B provide alternative explanations, C provides a counterexample, and D is irrelevant.

stimulus: The company's new marketing campaign increased sales by 30% last quarter. Therefore, the campaign was effective.
questionText: Which of the following, if true, most weakens the argument?
optionA: The company's competitors also increased their marketing spending
optionB: Sales increased by 25% the previous quarter without any campaign
optionC: The campaign cost more than anticipated
optionD: Some customers were unhappy with the campaign
optionE: The campaign targeted a different demographic than usual
explanation: This option weakens the argument by showing that sales were already increasing significantly without the campaign, suggesting the increase might not be due to the new campaign. This provides an alternative explanation for the sales increase.

stimulus: If the government raises taxes, the economy will suffer. The government will raise taxes next year. Therefore, the economy will suffer next year.
questionText: Which of the following, if assumed, would make the argument valid?
optionA: High taxes always harm economic growth
optionB: The government has raised taxes before
optionD: If the government raises taxes, the economy will suffer
optionE: Government policy directly affects economic outcomes
explanation: The argument already states this condition, so assuming it makes the argument logically valid. The conclusion follows necessarily from the premises if this assumption is true. This is what makes it a sufficient assumption.
